batch: 45 · DeepSeek V4.1-Flash rate card in force + V4-Pro scheduled rerouting, read 2026-09-10
collectedWith: curl of the vendor pricing page (server-rendered HTML, no CDP needed) plus the release post at /news/news260910 for the announcement context; HF API for V4.1-Flash license facts
schema: Model operating parameters, NOT benchmark scores. Price evidence only: two rows quoting the PEAK column of the new rate card that took effect 04:00 UTC on 2026-09-10. No benchmark observation in this file. The release post's benchmark tables are PNG images — deliberately not transcribed (cannot be read verbatim from pixels without a vision read, and the numbers are not needed for this batch's purpose).
note: DeepSeek replaced the 08-16 rate card with a cheaper one at 04:00 UTC on 2026-09-10, and the flash column changed model under the string: the page's MODEL VERSION row now reads 'DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash | DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813'. Footnote (1): legacy strings deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are still accepted but those models are RETIRED — requests are served by V4.1-Flash and billed at the Flash price. Footnote (2): from 12:00 Beijing time on 2026-09-14, until V4.1 Pro launches, ALL deepseek-v4-pro requests route to V4.1-Flash at V4.1-Flash rates. Identity: the flash column IS a new model this catalog has no record for, so its row is deliberately unmapped — banked evidence for the day a V4.1-Flash record exists (same pattern as batch-33's pro row sitting unmapped 08-16→08-19). The pro column still prices DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, which IS the catalog's deepseek-v4-pro record, and its peak prices are unchanged, so that row aliases file-scoped and confirms the catalog's current values rather than moving them.

tiersNotArchived.deepseek-flash: Off-peak (all hours outside 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC weekdays): $0.003 input cache-hit, $0.15 input cache-miss, $0.60 output per 1M tokens. Peak is the undiscounted rate and what a list-price catalog quotes (batch-31 quotingRule).
tiersNotArchived.deepseek-v4-pro: Off-peak, same windows: $0.022 input cache-hit, $0.66 input cache-miss, $1.98 output per 1M tokens — unchanged from the 08-16 card.

identityDisposition: deepseek-flash: archived UNMAPPED — it names DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (pinned by the page's own MODEL VERSION row), a model with no catalog record. Mapping it to deepseek-v4-flash would be exactly the wrong-attribution failure this project exists to prevent: the 0731 flash is retired and the prices differ ($0.44/$1.32 → $0.30/$1.20). deepseek-v4-pro: aliased file-scoped (file: batch-45) — on this page the string is pinned by the MODEL VERSION row to DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, the record's identity since 2026-08-19; globally the same bare string is REFUSED for the preview (see the 2026-08-19 refusal entry), so scope stays narrow.

priceTerms.note: Not a promotion — a scheduled string rerouting. From 12:00 Beijing time on 2026-09-14, deepseek-v4-pro requests route to V4.1-Flash and are billed at the Flash price ($0.30/$1.20 peak) until V4.1 Pro launches. This is the exact batch-31 pattern (announced price change with a start date): the catalog keeps quoting $1.32/$3.96 until the effective date, then the check goes red on its own and the record is re-archived from the page. Deliberately NOT applied early — a price that has not taken effect is not a list price. Cache price on the effective date will be $0.006 (flash peak cache-hit); not part of this term's in/out assertion.
